name: Retry on Insufficient Evidence
description: When a researcher loop fails, retry with a broader search strategy. Bounded by max_iterations + a when guard to prevent unbounded loops.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.retry
on_enter.prompt:
A previous research attempt found insufficient evidence. Try again with a broader approach:

1. Use different search queries (synonyms, related terms)
2. Try web_search if graph_query returned nothing
3. Check related entities in the knowledge graph
4. If still insufficient after thorough search, submit what you found with a note about gaps.

Original task: $entity.triple.agent.loop.description
